fpdf2 2.8.8 — CaseOps API third-party notice

Python distribution: fpdf2; Python import namespace: fpdf
Upstream project: https://github.com/py-pdf/fpdf2
Release: https://github.com/py-pdf/fpdf2/releases/tag/2.8.8
License: LGPL-3.0-only (the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 3 only).
This dependency is not MIT-licensed.

Upstream authors, as listed by the distribution metadata:
Olivier PLATHEY, Max, Lucas Cimon (@Lucas-C), Georg Mischler (@gmischler),
Anderson Herzogenrath da Costa (@andersonhc), and the fpdf2 contributors.

The API image installs the unmodified upstream library through its locked Python
requirements. CaseOps has not modified the fpdf2 library. The unmodified complete
source distribution is included alongside this notice as fpdf2-2.8.8.tar.gz.
Its original LICENSE is reproduced byte-for-byte. COPYING.GPLv3 supplies the GNU
GPL version 3 text incorporated by the LGPL version 3 additional permissions.
Artifact origins, exact SHA-256 digests, extents and release metadata are recorded
in provenance.json. The source archive can be unpacked independently with normal
tar tools; neither it nor any upstream build script is executed by verify.py.

The library remains a separate Python package. Recipients may replace or modify
it in their own copy of the API image, including for debugging those changes,
subject to the accompanying license terms. The library's source and license
must accompany any further distribution as required by those terms. This notice
does not add restrictions on the library or state that an entire application is
licensed under the LGPL. The API's application code and resource-access policy
are separate from the unmodified library.

These materials are API-only. They do not add fpdf2 to the JavaScript dependency
exception policy, browser image, mobile app, or public JavaScript notice bundle.
